data.name: ThemeDescription
data.value: Every theme and palette, applied to a real page: pick them, scope them to one region, and watch the buttons, badges, alerts and fields follow. A scope left unbound follows the visitor's own appearance preference.

data.name: ThemeSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings change the theme of the whole showcase, exactly as the appearance window of an application would.

data.name: ThemeAppearanceDescription
data.value: Light, dark, or follow the operating system.

data.name: ThemeDensityDescription
data.value: How much room controls and spacing take, for the nested scope below.

data.name: ThemeBackdropMotionDescription
data.value: Let the themed backdrop move, when the theme has one.

data.name: ThemeWindowDescription
data.value: The ready-made window that gathers every appearance setting in one place.

data.name: ThemeThemesDescription
data.value: Each tile previews its theme in a scope of its own. Selecting one applies it to the whole showcase.

data.name: ThemePalettesDescription
data.value: A palette recolours any theme. Selecting one applies it on top of the current theme.

data.name: ThemeCombinationsDescription
data.value: A theme and a palette are independent: a few pairings side by side, each in a scope of its own.

data.name: ThemeCombinationsCount
data.value: {0} themes and {1} palettes, {2} combinations, each in light and dark.

data.name: ThemeToggleHint
data.value: Switch the scope between light and dark without touching the rest of the page.

data.name: ThemeToggleAria
data.value: Toggle the appearance of the nested scope

data.name: ThemeAppearancesDescription
data.value: The same content in each appearance, side by side.

data.name: ThemeDensitiesDescription
data.value: The same content in each density, side by side.

data.name: ThemeFollowingDescription
data.value: A scope with no appearance parameter set follows the visitor's preference, and the appearance window and settings below change that preference.

data.name: IconsDescription
data.value: The icon set, one glyph at a time: its sizes, its accessible name, glyphs from another family, and the whole catalogue in a searchable grid.

data.name: IconsSettingsDescription
data.value: Pick a glyph, a size and an accessible label.

data.name: IconsSizeDescription
data.value: The rendered size of the icon.

data.name: IconsSelectedDescription
data.value: The glyph to show. Picking one in the gallery below updates this field.

data.name: IconsLabelDescription
data.value: Read by screen readers. Left empty, the icon is decorative and hidden from them.

data.name: IconsGlyphDescription
data.value: An icon accepts a glyph from another family, and file formats resolve to their own icon and colour.

data.name: IconsGalleryDescription
data.value: Filter by name and pick an icon to preview it above.

data.name: TypographyDescription
data.value: Headings, text, labels and links: every level, element and tone, plus truncation of text that does not fit.

data.name: TypographyHeadingSettingsDescription
data.value: The text, level and tone of the heading in the preview.

data.name: TypographyHeadingDefault
data.value: A heading that says what follows

data.name: TypographyLevelDescription
data.value: The outline level, from the page title down.

data.name: TypographyToneDescription
data.value: The semantic colour of the text.

data.name: TypographyTextSettingsDescription
data.value: The element, tone and truncation of the paragraph in the preview.

data.name: TypographyElementDescription
data.value: The markup the text is rendered with.

data.name: TypographyTruncateDescription
data.value: Cut text that does not fit on one line and add an ellipsis.

data.name: TypographyLabelsDescription
data.value: A label is bound to its field, and a link is internal or opens a new tab.

data.name: BadgesDescription
data.value: Short status labels: every tone and fill, readable ink on any background, icons, widths, and badges in context.

data.name: BadgesSettingsDescription
data.value: The tone, fill, label and icon of the badge in the preview.

data.name: BadgesVariantDescription
data.value: The semantic colour of the badge.

data.name: BadgesShapeDescription
data.value: The corners of the badge: pill by default.

data.name: BadgesShapesDescription
data.value: Pill is the default; Rounded keeps the small radius of the theme and Square has none. Colours and borders do not change.

data.name: BadgesLabelDescription
data.value: The text shown inside the badge.

data.name: BadgesWithIconDescription
data.value: Show an icon before the label.

data.name: BadgesMatrixDescription
data.value: Every fill for every tone, with counters below.

data.name: BadgesInkDescription
data.value: The ink colour is chosen for contrast against the badge background, whatever the theme.

data.name: BadgesIconsDescription
data.value: A badge can carry an icon before its label, or an icon alone.

data.name: BadgesWidthDescription
data.value: A badge grows with its label, up to the room it has.

data.name: ImagesDescription
data.value: Images with a fixed box: how they fit it, when they load, and which sources they accept.

data.name: ImagesSettingsDescription
data.value: The source, box, fit and loading of the image in the preview.

data.name: ImagesBoxDescription
data.value: The width and height the image is fitted into. Intrinsic leaves the box unset.

data.name: ImagesFitDescription
data.value: How the picture fills the box.

data.name: ImagesLoadingDescription
data.value: Eager loads at once, lazy waits until the image is near the viewport.

data.name: ImagesFitsDescription
data.value: The same picture in the same box, with each fit.

data.name: BadgesActionsDescription
data.value: A one-character badge is at least a square. With OnClick it becomes a real button, with Href a real link, both named by Label: a counter that opens what it counts, without a button around it.
